name: building-blocks-color-signals
title: Color Signals
description: Intentional Tailwind color blocks for semantic badges, tinted surfaces, and status dots with labels.
useWhen: Intentional Tailwind color blocks for semantic badges, tinted surfaces, and status dots with labels.
avoidWhen: Avoid color signals when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Color Signals uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
